name: Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS)
description: Each statement has four possible answers. Choose the one that matches how you feel; points are then totalled for each part.
instruction: Read each statement carefully and choose the answer that best describes how you have felt over the past week. Don't think too long about any statement: your first reaction is usually the most accurate.

1.text: I feel tense or wound up

2.text: I feel frightened, as if something awful is about to happen

choices.1: Definitely, and the fear is very strong
choices.2: Yes, but the fear is not very strong
choices.3: Sometimes, but it doesn't worry me

3.text: Worrying thoughts go through my mind

choices.3: From time to time, but not too often

4.text: I can sit at ease and feel relaxed

5.text: I feel inner tension or trembling

6.text: I feel restless, as if I have to be on the move

7.text: I get sudden feelings of panic

8.text: I still enjoy the things I used to enjoy

choices.3: Only to a very small extent

9.text: I can laugh and see the funny side of things

choices.3: Only to a very small extent

11.text: I feel as if I am slowed down

12.text: I have lost interest in my appearance

choices.2: I don't give it as much time as I should
choices.3: Perhaps I give it a little less time than before
choices.4: I take care of myself just as before

13.text: I believe my activities and interests can bring me satisfaction

choices.2: Yes, but not as much as before

14.text: I can enjoy a good book, radio or TV programme
